en.shortDescription: Baikal CardDAV/CalDAV server for contacts and calendars
en.longDescription:
Nextcloud Contacts companion based on Baikal — a lightweight CardDAV/CalDAV server with a web admin UI for address books and calendars.

Open SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_CONTACTS to complete the first-run wizard. CardDAV clients (including those used with Nextcloud Contacts) sync via /dav.php. Config and data persist under Baikal's config and Specific volumes.

fr.shortDescription: Serveur CardDAV/CalDAV Baikal pour contacts et calendriers
